resources.name: Task Tracker API
resources.description:
Complete API collection for the Task Tracker microservices platform.

All routes are proxied through the API Gateway on port 3000.
Every authenticated route is available on both /api/* and /api/v1/* prefixes.
Metrics endpoint is available on /api/v1/metrics only.

Workflow:
1. Run 'Register' or 'Login' to obtain a JWT token
2. Set the returned token as the jwt_token environment variable
3. All other requests will use this token automatically

resources.name: Auth
resources.description: Authentication endpoints — no token required

resources.name: Users
resources.description: User profile management — JWT required. List endpoint requires admin role.

resources.name: API Keys
resources.description: Manage scoped API keys (ttk_... format) — JWT required to create/list/revoke

resources.name: Teams
resources.description: Team CRUD and team membership management — JWT required

resources.name: Members
resources.description: Person/member directory CRUD — JWT required

resources.name: Tasks
resources.description: Task CRUD and summary aggregation — JWT required. Delete requires admin role.

resources.name: Progress
resources.description: Progress update history — JWT required. POST also syncs status back to task-service.

resources.name: Alerts
resources.description: Deadline and deviation alerts — JWT required. Detection cron runs daily at 06:00 UTC.

resources.name: Import
resources.description: Bulk CSV/XLSX import endpoints — JWT required, multipart/form-data, max 10 MB per file

resources.name: Metrics & Docs
resources.description: Prometheus metrics (v1 only) and OpenAPI/Swagger documentation (public)

resources.name: Health Checks
resources.description: Liveness endpoints — public, no auth required

resources.name: Register
resources.description: Create a new user account. Valid roles: member (default), admin.

resources.name: Login
resources.description: Authenticate with email + password. Copy the returned token into the jwt_token environment variable.

resources.name: Microsoft SSO Login
resources.description: Exchange an Azure AD id_token for a Task Tracker JWT. If the account already exists with a password, the response may include mergeRequired=true.

resources.name: Microsoft SSO Merge Account
resources.description: Link an existing email/password account to a Microsoft identity. Provide both the Azure id_token and the existing account password.

resources.name: List Users
resources.description: Admin role required. Returns all registered user accounts.

resources.name: Get User by ID
resources.description: Retrieve a single user profile. Users can fetch their own; admin can fetch any.

resources.name: Update User
resources.description: Update user fields such as name or role.

resources.name: Create API Key
resources.description: Issues a scoped ttk_... API key. The raw key is returned once — store it immediately. Valid permissions: tasks:read, tasks:write, progress:read, progress:write, alerts:read, alerts:write, teams:read, teams:write.

resources.name: List API Keys
resources.description: Returns all API keys owned by the authenticated user (raw key is not included).

resources.name: Revoke (Delete) API Key
resources.description: Soft-deletes (deactivates) an API key by its _id. Set apikey_id in environment first.

resources.name: Example — Authenticate with API Key
resources.description: Demonstrates using a ttk_... API key as a Bearer token instead of a user JWT. Set the api_key environment variable to your ttk_ key.

resources.name: List Teams
resources.description: Returns all teams.

resources.name: Get Team by ID
resources.description: Retrieve a single team with its members list.

resources.name: Create Team
resources.description: name: 2-100 chars. description: 0-500 chars (optional).

resources.name: Update Team
resources.description: At least one of name or description must be provided.

resources.name: Add Member to Team
resources.description: Assigns an existing member (by memberId) to a team.

resources.name: Remove Member from Team
resources.description: Removes a member from a team (does not delete the member record).

resources.name: List Members
resources.description: Returns all members in the directory.

resources.name: Create Member
resources.description: name: 1-100 chars. loginId: unique identifier, 1-100 chars. position, birthday, joiningDate are optional.

resources.name: Update Member
resources.description: At least one field must be provided. All fields are optional.

resources.name: List Tasks
resources.description: Returns all tasks the user has access to.

resources.name: Get Task Summary
resources.description: Aggregated task counts grouped by status and category. Used by the metrics endpoint internally.

resources.name: List Tasks by Team
resources.description: Returns all tasks assigned to a specific team. Set team_id in environment.

resources.name: Create Task
resources.description: Valid categories: 'Automation Testing Coverage', 'DR Dry Run', 'Active-Active Setup', 'LEAP Framework Adherence', 'Claude Code Adoption %', 'Open Operational Items', 'Security Risk Items'. Valid statuses: not_started, in_progress, blocked, completed, cancelled.

body.text:
{
  "title": "Implement DR Dry Run — Zone A failover",
  "description": "Simulate full failover to Zone A and validate RTO/RPO targets meet the SLA",
  "category": "DR Dry Run",
  "assignedTeamId": "{{team_id}}",
  "assignedPersonId": "{{member_id}}",
  "status": "not_started",
  "completionPct": 0,
  "plannedStartDate": "2026-04-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "dueDate": "2026-06-30T00:00:00.000Z",
  "nextUpdateDate": "2026-04-15T00:00:00.000Z"
}

resources.name: Update Task
resources.description: All fields are optional. Provide only fields to change.

resources.name: Delete Task
resources.description: Admin role required.

resources.name: Post Progress Update
resources.description: Records a progress update and fire-and-forgets a sync back to task-service to update completionPct and status. completionPct: 0-100. nextUpdateDate: null clears the field.

body.text:
{
  "taskId": "{{task_id}}",
  "teamId": "{{team_id}}",
  "completionPct": 40,
  "status": "in_progress",
  "comment": "Zone A failover script complete. Starting Zone B validation.",
  "nextUpdateDate": "2026-05-01T00:00:00.000Z"
}

resources.name: Get Progress History for Task
resources.description: Returns all progress entries for a task, ordered newest first.

resources.name: Get Latest Progress for Task
resources.description: Returns the single most recent progress entry for a task.

resources.name: Get Progress Updates by Team
resources.description: Returns all progress entries submitted by a team, across all tasks.

resources.name: List All Alerts
resources.description: Returns all active and resolved alerts across all tasks.

resources.name: List Alerts by Team
resources.description: Returns alerts for tasks assigned to the specified team.

resources.name: Resolve Alert
resources.description: Marks an active alert as resolved (isActive = false). Set alert_id in environment.

resources.name: Trigger Alert Detection (Manual)
resources.description: Manually executes the same logic as the daily cron at 06:00 UTC. Useful for testing or backfilling alerts.

resources.name: Import Tasks (CSV/XLSX)
resources.description: Upload a CSV or Excel file to bulk-import tasks. File field name must be 'file'. Max 10 MB.

params.name: file
params.description: CSV or XLSX file. Columns: title, description, category, assignedTeamId, assignedPersonId, status, completionPct, plannedStartDate, dueDate, nextUpdateDate

resources.name: Import Teams (CSV/XLSX)
resources.description: Bulk-import teams from a CSV or Excel file. Max 10 MB.

params.name: file
params.description: CSV or XLSX file. Columns: name, description

resources.name: Import Members (CSV/XLSX)
resources.description: Bulk-import person/member records from a CSV or Excel file. Max 10 MB.

params.name: file
params.description: CSV or XLSX file. Columns: name, loginId, position, birthday, joiningDate

resources.name: Import Team-Member Assignments (CSV/XLSX)
resources.description: Bulk-assign members to teams from a CSV or Excel file. Max 10 MB.

params.name: file
params.description: CSV or XLSX file. Columns: teamId, memberId

resources.name: Prometheus Metrics
resources.description: Returns task and alert counts in Prometheus text exposition format (text/plain; version=0.0.4). Available on /api/v1/ prefix ONLY. No user auth required — the gateway uses SERVICE_TOKEN internally to query downstream services.

resources.name: OpenAPI Spec (JSON)
resources.description: Returns the full OpenAPI 3.0 spec describing all gateway routes.

resources.name: Swagger UI
resources.description: Interactive HTML documentation. Open in a browser for the full Swagger UI experience.
